name: TetraSDF
aliases: Analytic Isosurface Extraction with Multi-resolution Tetrahedral Grid
definition: TetraSDF is an analytic isosurface extraction framework for SDFs that represents the SDF with a ReLU MLP composed with a multi-resolution tetrahedral positional encoder. It retains the expressiveness of grid-based encoders while enabling exact zero-level set extraction by preserving a global continuous piecewise affine (CPWA) structure via barycentric interpolation.
